Appearance
From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Fase

Asturian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Ancient Greek φάσις (phásis, “appearance”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfase/ [ˈfa.se]
  • Rhymes: -ase
  • Syllabification: fa‧se

Noun

[edit]

fase f (plural fases)

  1. (astronomy, physics) phase
  2. phase (part of a sequence or cycle); stage, period
    Synonym: etapa

Danish

[edit]

[edit]

From French phase, from Ancient Greek φάσις (phásis).

Noun

[edit]

fase c (singular definite fasen, plural indefinite faser)

  1. phase
    Synonyms: trin, stadium
  2. (physics) state at a particular time in a system that is in periodic oscillations
  3. (chemistry) homogeneous component of a heterogeneous mixture

Indonesian

[edit]
Indonesian Wikipedia has an article on:
fase
Wikipedia id

Etymology

[edit]

From Dutch phase (current spelling fase), from New Latin phasis, from Ancient Greek φάσις (phásis, “an appearance”), from φάειν (pháein, “to shine”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Indonesian) IPA(key): /ˈfasə/ [ˈfa.sə]
  • Rhymes: -asə
  • Syllabification: fa‧se

Noun

[edit]

fasê (plural fase-fase)

  1. phase:
    1. a distinguishable part of a sequence or cycle occurring over time
      Synonyms: jangka, tingkat
    2. (astronomy) particular appearance or state in a regularly recurring cycle
      fase bulan ― lunar phase
    3. (chemistry) a component in a material system that is distinguished by chemical composition and/or physical state (solid, liquid or gas) and/or crystal structure. It is delineated from an adjoining phase by an abrupt change in one or more of those conditions
      fase padat ― solid phase
    4. (electrical engineering) in a polyphase electrical power system, one of the power-carrying conductors, or the alternating current carried by it
      sistem tenaga listrik 3 fase ― 3 phase electrical power system

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • fasa (Standard Malay)

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Ancient Greek φάσις (phásis, “appearance”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfa.ze/
  • Rhymes: -aze
  • Hyphenation: fà‧se

Noun

[edit]

fase f (plural fasi)

  1. phase, stage, period, level, degree, step
    Synonyms: stadio, grado, livello, periodo, passaggio
  2. (mechanics) stroke
  3. line (the engine is in line / out of line - with reference to smooth working)

Derived terms

  • fase luteale

  • fasometro

  • sfasare

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • phase (pre-standardization spelling)

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Ancient Greek φάσις (phásis, “appearance”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈfa.zi/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈfa.zi/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈfa.ze/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈfa.zɨ/

  • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -azi, (Portugal) -azɨ
  • Hyphenation: fa‧se

Noun

[edit]

fase f (plural fases)

  1. phase
  2. stage
  3. period
  4. (Brazil, video games) level (discrete segment of a game)
    Synonyms: nível, level
    Tô com dificuldade de passar essa fase. ― I'm having trouble beating this level.
